items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Maxine Sullivan) does not speak in the provided context; the mention of Ed Beech is made entirely by the Interviewer.

ctx.x: Mine? I've got over 2,000 LP's. Now listen to this. What is the name of the gentleman that was on WEVD, no, not WEVD, WRVR, disk jockey.

Ed Beech. Now listen to this -- when Ed Beech, they were getting ready to take him off the air, a friend of mine who is a doctor borrowed $10,000 to buy part of his collection. But he never bought it because people started writing in to keep him on the air. But since then he's gone off. Now, I'll tell you why I didn't take music up professionally.
